shortBio.en: Deep Purple Mark II guitar; exits 1975 to Rainbow with neoclassical leads.
shortBio.zh: Deep Purple Mark II 吉他；1975 离队组建 Rainbow，新古典主音。

whyHub.en: Purple → Rainbow personnel bridge; riff classroom to fantasy-lyric hard rock.
whyHub.zh: Purple → Rainbow 人事桥；从 riff 课堂到奇幻歌词 hard rock。

body.en:
Born 1945. Blues-classical figures on In Rock and Machine Head; Smoke on the Water open-fifth riff. Leaves Purple 1975; forms Rainbow with Dio-era fantasy lyric hard rock.

Hub: same right hand, new logo and lyric mode.
body.zh:
1945 年生。In Rock 与 Machine Head 上的蓝调—古典音型；Smoke on the Water 开放五度 riff。1975 离队 Purple；与 Dio 时期 Rainbow 做奇幻歌词 hard rock。

枢纽：同一右手，新 logo 与歌词模式。

note.en: Dio years and later commercial chapters.
note.zh: Dio 年与后期商业章节。
